These activities have to be performed for every application software component. | Comment: -
caption: Figure 13: Per component part of the AUTOSAR methodology The main workflow in Figure 13 runs from the left to the right. The initial work in this context starts with providing the necessary parts of the software component template [SWCTempl]. That means at least the Component Internal Behavior Description as part of the software component related templates has to be filled out. The internal behavior describes the scheduling relevant aspects of a component, i.e. the runnable entities and the events they respond to. Furthermore, the behavior specifies how a component (or more precisely which runnable) responds to events like received data elements. However, it does not describe the detailed functional behavior of the component. In practice an AUTOSAR authoring tool will support editing the Component Internal Behavior Description.
